subject: Pilot access paused — PO under validation (CBH-2089) — request for short runway
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Anil Rao <anil.rao@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access paused — PO under validation (CBH-2089)

Hi Lauren,

Quick note from our procurement team — they flagged the vendor paperwork for our pilot and put the PO (CBH-2089) into a verification queue. The finance contact says it could take 7–10 business days to clear (we're mid-audit).

We currently have a full sandbox running and a small engineering team relying on the sandbox for a demo next week. Is there any way Redwood can either:

- pause the trial timer while procurement verifies the PO, or
- provision short-term access (a 7–10 day voucher) so our engineers don't lose the state we've built?

We can share the purchase order and the SOW (attached) if that helps. Apologies for the inconvenience — we want to keep momentum while legal/finance finish their checks.

Thank you,

Priya Singh
Head of Data & Analytics
ClearBridge Health
(Attached: SOW_v2.pdf)
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access paused — PO under validation (CBH-2089)

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and for sending the SOW. I checked the account and I understand how disruptive that pause is for your demo cadence.

We have a couple of short-term options we can move on quickly:

1) Freeze the pilot timer for up to 10 calendar days while finance completes verification (internal approval required).
2) Issue a one-time 10-day voucher (no charge) to keep the sandbox live and preserve state.

To proceed with either option I need: the PO number (you provided CBH-2089 — thanks), an ETA for when procurement expects to clear it, and a confirmation that the team will accept a 10-day runway. If you're okay I will loop in Camila (AE) and request approval from our finance lead for the voucher.

If it helps, we can also provide a short amendment to the SOW highlighting the pilot window preservation while PO is validated.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks for looping me in, Lauren / Priya.

Internal note for Lauren: I spoke with finance this morning — they are open to issuing a short-term voucher to preserve a pilot when a PO is known and in-flight, provided we document the agreement and link it to the HubSpot deal and the incoming PO. I'll need Aditya's sign-off to finalize the voucher.

Priya — could you confirm: expected PO clearance date (best estimate) and whether the team needs the full sandbox (all seats + data) or a reduced token allotment? That will help us size the voucher.

Proposed next steps:
- Priya confirms PO ETA and access needs.
- We draft a one-page voucher terms doc and attach it to the HubSpot deal.
- Aditya signs off and we provision the 10-day voucher.

(Referencing attached: SOW_v2.pdf from Priya.)

Camila Reyes

camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Thanks team — I reviewed the deal and the SOW. Given the PO is submitted and the account is actively engaged, I approve a one-time 10-calendar-day voucher to preserve the pilot environment and state. No charge. Terms: voucher expires if PO not received within the 10-day window, and any extended concessions will require formal approval.

Camila — please draft the voucher_terms_draft.pdf, add it to HubSpot (deal CBH-2089), and provision the voucher for ClearBridge Health today. Lauren — loop back to Priya once provisioned.

Aditya Rao

Appreciate the quick response and the help keeping our engineers unblocked.
